text.text_excerpt: Wow, just WOW! Coalesce Goods is one of my TOP FAVORITE places for vegan food in the whole metropolitan area of New Orleans! Also, Jasmine put the sweetest and oh-so-appropriate affirmations on our to-go containers, it made the meal even better! The Boudin Balls are ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!! (Ours said "The universe supports you" on the box, which I so needed to hear that day! ) You have to try the vegan Boudin Balls from Coalesce Goods and the sauce they come with OMG it's honestly almost *too good* Hands down the best Buffalo Mac & cheese I've ever had! The chicken is so juicy and tasty and the Mac & cheese itself is cheesy and delicious! We also had the brisket and jalapeño cornbread biscui...

Oh, this place makes me so happy! I recall when St. Roch Market opened years ago and I was hopeful for a 100% vegan food stand, or even a stand with decent options, but there was not a single one to be found. Fast forward 5 or 6 years and Coalesce Goods is here for us! The menu is just right, with breakfast options and vegan takes on Southern favorites like boudin balls (sadly sold out by the late point in the day that I ate lunch) and a brisket plate. I opted for a little bit of healthy ("tuna" bowl) and a little bit of decadence (oatmeal cookie sandwich). That "tuna" bowl is deceptively simple. It's incredibly fresh and delicious and I poured that magical dressing over the heaping porti...

Berry Berry Poptart. Order a dozen y'all. I am mind-effin-blown. Coalesce Goods is a trio of rockstars who are helping to evolve the Vegan eats scene around town through their pop-ups and catering. Had the chance to catch them at Drink Beauty on Magazine to only find out they also have a rotating schedule at The Drifter and a few other spots in town. A women-owned, Black-owned business who is absolutely worth supporting and they are also Open To All which is amazing. (Gosh I love this city and how welcoming we are) Anywho... back to the poptart. I am ok with the sugar rush I'm on right now because the icing to bread ratio WAS LEGIT. Every bite had icing and they did not skimp out whatsoev...
